How well did the responses address the course content related to this question? How well did the 
responses integrate the skills required on this question? 

Part (a)  

• 
Most responses were able to correctly interpret the meaning of this integral. 

• 
Most of the responses also gave correct units. The few errors seen in providing the units were typically a failure to 
include “gallons” or a reference to time. 

• 
Responses were largely successful in approximating the value of 
( )
135

_{60} f t dt
∫
 using a right Riemann sum. Only a 

few responses had errors in setting up the approximation—for example, some used a left Riemann sum instead.
